Class PresetDialogAndToastHelper

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.preset.PresetDialogAndToastHelper
public final class PresetDialogAndToastHelper extends Object
Modal dialog, JSON import/export file chooser, inline confirmation bar, and toast notification helper for PresetControlBar.

Extracted in accordance with the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP) to decouple user confirmation workflows and transient toast animations from the core preset toolbar control.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
